defs.def: to move easily over a smooth or wet surface; to make sth move in this way （使）滑行，滑动

ex.s: While Emily was driving on a narrow stretch of road, her car slid into a ditch (沟).
ex.t: 当Emily行驶在一段狭窄的路上时，她的车滑进了沟里。

ex.s: The Barcelona subway pulls into the station, the doors slide open and passengers pour out to go about their daily business.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那地铁驶入车站，车门滑开，乘客们鱼贯而出，各自忙碌日常事务。

ex.s: It is so easy to let an online course slide, but your grades will suffer as a result.
ex.t: 在加拿大北部严酷的生存环境下，因纽特人的实用主义道德观是非常合理的。

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.

defs.def: to move quickly and quietly, for example in order not to be noticed; to make sth move in this way （使）快捷而悄声地移动
to become gradually lower or of less value 逐渐降低；贬值
to move gradually into a worse situation 衰落（成）；逐渐陷入；逐渐衰退（到）
a change to a lower or worse condition 降低；跌落；衰落
a long, smooth movement on ice or a smooth surface （在冰上或光滑表面上的）滑行，滑动
a structure with a steep slope that children use for sliding down 滑梯

ex.s: Since our twins began learning to walk, my wife and I have kept telling them that our sliding glass door is just a window.
ex.t: 这个   41   是显而易见的。

defs.def: a sudden fall of a large amount of rock or earth down a hill 山崩；岩崩；土崩；崩塌
a small piece of film held in a frame that can be shown on a screen when you shine a light through it 幻灯片
one page of an electronic presentation, that may contain text and images, that is usually viewed on a computer screen or projected onto a larger screen 幻灯片

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 理解历史对于我们理解作为一个民族和一个国家的我们自己至关重要。历史不仅仅是研究布满灰尘的旧物和久远的事件。它是我们今天是谁以及我们将要成为谁的重要组成部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛使理解历史变得令人兴奋、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

defs.def: a small piece of glass that sth is placed on so that it can be looked at under a microscope 载物玻璃片

ex.s: When our rifles were empty, the old wolf was down, and a pup was dragging a leg into impassable slide-rocks.
ex.t: 当我们的步枪子弹打光时，老狼倒下了，一只幼狼拖着一只腿爬进了无法通行的滑石堆。

ex.t: 反思 4 向全班展示你的幻灯片。

ex.s: These homes can easily collapse during earthquakes or slip and slide downhill in landslides, especially after heavy rain.
ex.t: 这些房屋在地震中容易倒塌，或者在滑坡中滑下山坡，尤其是在大雨之后。

defs.def: a part of a musical instrument or other device that slides backwards and forwards （乐器上的）拉管，滑管，滑动装置

ex.s: You should include: • introduction to your interviewees • how they used to live • how their lifestyles have changed • what you think we can learn from these changes Present your slides to the class.
ex.t: 你的幻灯片应包括：• 受访者介绍 • 他们以前的生活方式 • 他们的生活方式如何改变 • 你认为我们能从这些变化中学到什么 向全班展示你的幻灯片。

ex.t: 我明天有个演讲，需要完成我的幻灯片。
